issues: M5 acceptance test fails: dynamic import in __tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts throws TypeError "A dynamic import callback was invoked without --experimental-vm-modules". The test uses `await import('../../src/lib/receiptStore')`. The current Jest setup (babel-jest transform) does not support dynamic import without the Node --experimental-vm-modules flag, despite the test script including it. The fix should enable proper handling of dynamic imports in tests, e.g., by configuring Babel to use the `babel-plugin-dynamic-import-node` plugin or by disabling transformation of test files (set `transformIgnorePatterns` to include test files) so that Node's native dynamic import works. Update Babel config (`babel.config.js`) or Jest config to ensure dynamic imports are processed correctly, eliminating the TypeError.
feedback: The newly added hardening code passes unit tests but breaks the acceptance test due to improper handling of dynamic imports. Adjust the test environment configuration (Babel/Jest) so the acceptance suite can use dynamic import without errors.
